text:
Anthropic released Claude 4 as two models, Opus 4 and Sonnet 4, on May 8, 2025 [Source: ev-1]. This dual-model strategy aimed to capture both high-end reliability needs with the flagship Opus 4 (priced at $15 per million input tokens and $75 per million output tokens) and cost-effective development requirements with the faster workhorse Sonnet 4 (positioned as the developer-default model priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens) [Source: ev-1].

The launch signaled that agentic coding had become a defining market segment in 2025, with Claude Code emerging as its key product [Source: ev-1]. A major signal of this shift was the improved capability of Claude 4’s “computer use 2.0” feature for browser control, which was roughly twice as reliable as the previous generation [Source: ev-1]. By positioning these models for safety and reliability, Anthropic reported record API usage driven by Claude Code adoption, ultimately cementing its position as a coding-agent leader that led to a large funding round in late September 2025 at a reported valuation of approximately $183 billion [Source: ev-1].
